g.text: Stunted: too short for their age

text.style: font-size: 16px; font-family: 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', 'Liberation Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', sans-serif; fill: #111111

g.text: Expected height of boys and girls, from birth to age

text.style: font-size: 16px; font-family: 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', 'Liberation Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', sans-serif; fill: #111111
font-size: 10.5px; font-family: 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', 'Liberation Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', sans-serif; fill: #555555

g.text: Read it like this: the line is the height at which half of children of that age are

text.style: font-size: 10.5px; font-family: 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', 'Liberation Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', sans-serif; fill: #555555

g.text: taller and half are shorter. The darker band covers the middle 8 in 10 children,

text.style: font-size: 10.5px; font-family: 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', 'Liberation Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', sans-serif; fill: #555555

g.text: and the lighter band almost all of them — 999 in every 1,000. Girls are taller

text.style: font-size: 10.5px; font-family: 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', 'Liberation Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', sans-serif; fill: #555555

g.text: than boys, on average, between the ages of about 9 and 13. Up to age 5 these

text.style: font-size: 10.5px; font-family: 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', 'Liberation Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', sans-serif; fill: #555555

g.text: are standards, showing how children grow in good conditions; from age 5 they

text.style: font-size: 10.5px; font-family: 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', 'Liberation Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', sans-serif; fill: #555555

g.text: are a reference, showing how an earlier sample did grow.

text.style: font-size: 8.75px; font-family: 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', 'Liberation Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #888888

g.text: Data source: WHO Child Growth Standards (2006); WHO Growth Reference (2007)

text.style: font-size: 8.75px; font-family: 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', 'Liberation Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: end; fill: #888888
